jobs.description:
A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.

For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.

You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.

International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.

Functieomschrijving
 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 

• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 

• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 

• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

Are you detail-oriented, client-focused, and experienced in KYC and compliance processes? We are looking for a Client Administration Officer to play a key role in managing client files and ensuring compliance within a leading financial services environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established and reputable financial institution specializing in wealth management and investment services. With a strong focus on expertise, long-term relationships, and service excellence, the company offers a collaborative and professional work environment where employees are encouraged to grow and develop their careers.

Omschrijving

• Manage the full lifecycle of client files, from onboarding to closure.
• Perform AML/KYC checks and assess client documentation and risk profiles.
• Collect, verify, and maintain accurate client data.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with commercial, legal, and compliance teams.
• Identify and report operational risks when necessary.
• Participate in various departmental and process improvement projects.

• Previous experience in a similar administrative, KYC, compliance, or client support role within the financial services sector.
• Good knowledge of AML, KYC, MiFID, FATCA, CRS, GDPR, or similar regulations.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• A proactive team player with strong communication abilities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we're looking for: 100% EV Car Technicians. 

In this role you'll be responsible for troubleshooting, car diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, ... 

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification + working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.​

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

You work organized as you will have to create reports to show results of the performed activities.

jobs.occupation: Road Logistics Full & Part Loads Teamleader International
jobs.description:
Company Overview
Kuehne+Nagel is a leading global logistics provider, known for its innovative supply chain solutions and strong customer focus. For our Road Logistics division in Belgium, we are looking for a proactive and experienced Team Leader Dispatching to oversee and coordinate the daily activities of our dispatch team. This role involves managing operations for both full truckloads (FTL) and part loads (LTL), while supporting our dedicated groupage department and cross-dock activities, which form a crucial part of our transport network.
 

Position Summary
As a Team Leader, you oversee and guide a team of Dispatchers who specialize in chartering LTL and FTL shipments within our Road Logistics department in Kampenhout. You are responsible for coordinating and monitoring daily transport activities, ensuring that all shipments are dispatched efficiently, cost effectively, and in full compliance with Belgian transport regulations. Leveraging your operational expertise and strong communication skills, you support your team in working effectively with planners, drivers, subcontractors, and customer service teams. Together, you ensure smooth execution of all transport movements, selecting the most suitable subcontractors based on quality, performance, and price, while fostering continuous operational improvement within the team.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• You are the direct manager of a team of 8 to 12 transport planners. This includes target setting and follow-up, yearly evaluations and disciplinary actions if applicable. You make sure that work is divided evenly within the team and look for the “right person“on the “right job“.  

• You are the first point of contact for escalations within your team. You act as a coach and a knowledge expert and provide support to your employees in case of questions. 

• You supervise the daily operational scheduling and actively identify new opportunities within your team to improve services or reduce costs. 

• You Identify Trends through preset KPI’s and act where needed. 

• You are responsible for optimizing operational and administrative processes for more efficiency and actively propose improvement projects.   

 
 

 

Qualifications
 
 

•  Bachelor’s degree in supply chain or equivalent by experience  

•  Proven experience in Logistics, preferably road freight & planning 

• Experience in managing a team 

•  Hand on Mentality & flexible mindset.  

•  IT Savvy, ability to work in different IT systems and programs.  

•  Knowledge of Dutch, English and French. Any other language is an asset.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

• Harvesting flowers

• Cleaning up the fields, removing leftover materials and carrying out minor maintenance tasks

• All other practical tasks needed to keep the horticultural production running smoothly

• Outdoor and physically demanding work as part of your daily routine

• You are physically fit and have no problem bending, lifting or working in different weather conditions

• You are reliable, punctual and motivated

• You enjoy working hard in a dynamic environment

• You can communicate in Dutch, French or English

• You are flexible and potentially available to work weekends

Working hours:

Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Occasional Saturdays, depending on workload or weather conditions

All overtime hours are paid

The Logistics Centre in Grimbergen is recognized as one of the world's leading facilities, reflecting the company's commitment to excellence across all operations.

Jobomschrijving

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed
• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks
• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations
• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background
• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)
• Hands-on and dynamic approach
• Precision and results-oriented mindset
• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility
• Team player who can also work independently
• Preferably experienced in welding
• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

As a Talent & Business Consultant, you will play a key role in connecting top technology professionals with leading businesses across Belgium.

Operating at the intersection of people and business, you will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and candidates while building your own network and market expertise.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international consultancy specialized in Technology and Digital Transformation recruitment. They partner with innovative startups, scale-ups, and global organizations to help them attract the talent shaping tomorrow's digital world.

Driven by entrepreneurship, excellence, and collaboration, they empower their consultants to build strong market expertise, develop meaningful business relationships, and make a lasting impact on companies and professionals alike.

 

Description

Develop your client portfolio

• Build and maintain relationships with technology leaders and hiring managers.
• Identify new business opportunities and expand existing partnerships.
• Understand clients' growth plans, challenges, and recruitment needs.
• Advise clients on talent market trends and hiring strategies.

Connect with top talent

Drive successful recruitment projects

• Speak English with at least a native level in French OR Dutch.

• Have a strong commercial mindset.

• Are naturally curious and eager to learn about businesses and industries.

• Are resilient, proactive, and results-oriented.
Experience in sales, consulting, business development, customer success, hospitality, banking, or recruitment is considered a plus.

• Experience with diagnostic tools.

• Team player but can also work independently

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.

• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.

• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.

• Use Tree View on daily basis.

• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.

• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.

• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.

• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.

• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).

• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 

• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.

• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.

• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)

• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.

• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)

• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.

• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.

• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch

• IATA certification is a plus.

• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

Team/division description:
 

Lexus, One Omnichannel Experience (Lexus, OCX) is the Function that is the promoting the LEXUS brand 360 degree and delivers one seamless omnichannel experience across physical and digital touchpoints. The Function brings under one roof Divisions such as Lexus Brand, Digital Experience & E-Commerce, Data Platforms & Customer Engagement Management (CEM), Customer Relations, Strategy & Performance, and One Academy. Its mission is to define and connect every customer touchpoint across the ONE TOYOTA Ecosystem in an omnichannel way to drive conversion, loyalty and monetisation. AI based automation and self-services are unlocking cost efficiencies, while a system of actionable insights is leading to continuous performance improvements. A unified, centrally governed and legally compliant data foundation is the key enabler for building long term trusted relationships with our customers.
 

Due to its multiple impact across the business, the function should collaborate seamlessly with other TME functions and NMSCs as the primary implementer.
 

Your task: 
 

 
• Agenda, Mailbox, Expense & Travel Management: Manage the Function Head’s agenda, mailbox, travel booking, and expenses.
 
• Team Travel & Expenses: Support team Heads with travel and expenses upon request.
 
• Travel Coordination: Share travel-related information across the function.
 
• All Team meeting organization: Organize Quarterly All Team meeting – book venue, collect and consolidate presentations from each team, present team related content.
 
• Weekly Direct reports meeting / Bi-Weekly Lexus Team Meeting: set-up meeting (including meeting room), consolidate PowerPoint presentation for the meetings, create midterm agenda visibility.
 
• Off-site Meetings: Coordinate logistics, including hotels, catering, venues, and registration.
 
• Events: Organise Christmas parties and team-building activities.
 
• Mailing Lists & Org Charts: Keep mailing groups and organisation charts up to date.
 
• Office Management: Coordinate daily office operations, meeting rooms, and group calendars.
 
• (Oracle Finance system) PR/PO & Supplier Creation: Create PR/Pos when needed (such as special office supply ordering, Teambuilding down payment)
 
• Facilities: Coordinate facility matters, locker lists, and Kara-Kara clean-up activities.
 
• Ad-hoc Support: Support team members with ad-hoc requests.
 
• One Team Sprit: Support the leadership team in building a One Team Sprit considering the diversity of the divisions. 

Your profile:
 

 
• Reliable, Accurate & Proactive: Attention to detail, highly precise, strong organisational skills.
 
• Persistent, Stress-resistant & Hard-working: Focused and resilient in a demanding environment.
 
• Team Player and Independent Worker: Collaborates well and manages tasks independently.
 
• Multicultural Communication: Communicates effectively in diverse environments.
 
• Results-driven: Turns objectives into clear, tangible actions.
 
• Communication and Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly and professionally.
 
• Planning and Organisation: Manages priorities and multiple tasks efficiently.
 
• Discreet: Handles confidential information professionally and with high integrity.
 
• Microsoft Office Skills: Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams.
 
• Fluent in English: Other languages are an asset.

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

jobs.occupation: Business development manager DACH region - fixed contract
jobs.description:
Searching for a job in sales?
Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?
The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a business development manager who will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities across the German-speaking market (Dach region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will play a pivotal role in expanding the company’s footprint, strengthening relationships with distributors in various markets.

• You will identify and pursue new business opportunities within the DACH region.
• Relationships with distributors and resellers will you build and maintain.
• For accounts in this region, you will serve as the primary point of contact.
• You will develop tailored solutions and proposals to meet specific customer needs.
• The market trends and competitor activities will you analyze to identify growth opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).
• Strong understanding of the DACH market and cultural nuances.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships.
• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM tools.
